Kotak Mahindra Bank CEO Ashok Vaswani to step down in 2026

Ashok Vaswani, the CEO of Kotak Mahindra Bank, has announced he will not seek reappointment after his current term concludes on December 31, 2026. He cited personal reasons for his decision. The bank has begun the process to identify and appoint a successor to lead the institution.
